name: scopus-plus-mcp
description: Scopus and more: search, full text, citation networks, journal quality and bibliometrics; OpenAlex without a subscription.
long_description: Search Scopus and ScienceDirect full text, trace citation lineages, map coupling and co-citation networks, scope reviews by field and journal quartile, and get counts, metrics and BibTeX. OpenAlex covers the same analyses without a Scopus subscription. Not affiliated with Elsevier.

tools.name: search_scopus
tools.description: Search for documents in Scopus using a query string.

tools.name: search_all
tools.description: Search Scopus (or OpenAlex with source='openalex') and page through results automatically, returning up to max_results entries in one call.

tools.name: search_fulltext
tools.description: Search the full text of Elsevier (ScienceDirect) journal articles, not just titles and abstracts: finds papers that use a construct in their body without naming it up front.

tools.name: get_abstract_details
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a specific document by Scopus ID.

tools.name: resolve_identifier
tools.description: Resolve any document identifier (Scopus ID, EID, DOI, or PII) to the full cross-reference set (scopus_id, eid, doi, pii, title).

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description: Find authors by name, optionally narrowed by affiliation.

tools.name: get_author_profile
tools.description: Retrieve an author's profile by Author ID.

tools.name: get_fulltext
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a paper via a provider waterfall: (1) ScienceDirect full text (requires SCOPUS_INSTTOKEN or institutional IP), (2) open-access copy: every open location in OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar's open PDF and arXiv ID, arXiv by exact title, Europe PMC, and Unpaywall or CORE when configured; published versions first, and the result names the source and version (preprint, accepted manuscript, published), (3) Scopus abstract fallback.

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Retrieve the cited-reference list of a document (Backward Citations) via the Abstract Retrieval REF view.

tools.name: get_citing_papers
tools.description: Retrieve a list of papers that have cited the specified document (Forward Citations).

tools.name: bibliographic_coupling
tools.description: Build a bibliographic-coupling graph for a set of seed papers.

tools.name: co_citation
tools.description: Build a co-citation graph for a set of seed papers.

tools.name: citation_lineage
tools.description: Walk the citation lineage of a seed paper across multiple generations.

tools.name: publication_counts
tools.description: Count publications per year for a query, e.g.

tools.name: topic_landscape
tools.description: Where and at what prestige a topic is published.

tools.name: get_journal_metrics
tools.description: Journal metrics for a list of journals, e.g.

tools.name: find_journals
tools.description: List the journals in one or more Scopus subject categories at or above a CiteScore percentile within that category: the quality cut-off for scoping a literature review (Q1 = 75, top 10% = 90).

tools.name: get_bibtex
tools.description: BibTeX entries for a list of papers, written to a .bib file and returned inline.

tools.name: diagnose_connection
tools.description: Diagnose Scopus connectivity and entitlement.

tools.name: get_quota_status
tools.description: Get the current API quota status (remaining/limit).

tools.name: get_server_info
tools.description: Return the server version and a health summary.

scopus_api_key.title: Scopus API key
scopus_api_key.description: From dev.elsevier.com. Stored securely by Claude.

insttoken.title: Institutional token (optional)
insttoken.description: Gives subscriber access off campus. Leave empty on your institution's network.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key (optional)
openalex_api_key.description: Free key from openalex.org; raises the daily OpenAlex budget tenfold.

output_directory.title: Output folder
output_directory.description: Where result, network, BibTeX and full-text files are saved.
